_comment: Offline HTTP fixtures for demo mode (spec 021). Maps the exact URL each importer builds from config/feeds.example.txt to a response body in this directory. Demo mode serves these instead of the network; a URL with no entry raises OfflineFixtureError rather than falling through to a request, so the demo cannot become quietly network-dependent. Every body is authored, not recorded: no real board was scraped, so no real company or person appears (test_demo.py::test_fixtures_reference_only_reserved_domains).
